subject: The truth about what happened this month
preview_text: I just ran the numbers from the last 30 days. What our community did is absolutely wild. You need to see this.
body_paragraphs: Okay, I just closed the spreadsheet and I'm honestly a little stunned. I tallied up all the data from our PupShape community for the past month. The results are not what I expected. Not even close.

This month alone, 47 dogs hit their target weight. That's nearly one dog every single day getting healthier. The average weight loss was 12% in just four weeks. But here's the secret that blew my mind: the dogs whose owners used the progress tracker feature lost weight 40% faster than those who didn't. They weren't doing more exercise. They weren't on a stricter diet. They were just consistent with one simple thing.

Every single one of those success stories started in the same place: the 'Before & After' timeline in the app. It's not just for photos. It's the visual proof that keeps you going on day 15 when you feel stuck. It's the reason those 47 owners didn't quit. They could see the change, pixel by pixel, pound by pound.

Open the app right now. Go to your dog's profile and tap 'Progress Timeline'. Upload a current photo if you haven't. That's your starting line. In 30 days, you'll be one of the stories I'm writing about. P.S. The most successful users update their timeline every Sunday night. It takes 60 seconds and it's the single biggest predictor of whether a dog hits their goal.
